Industry obligation: Obtain board approval to adopt the Code and name a senior executive
Due logic: Keep the board decision, executive mandate and third-party flow-down controls together.
Evidence: Board minutes, executive appointment, contracts and training

Trigger: Certificate renewal or supporting document expiry
Due logic: Use the earliest supporting-document expiry as an internal alert.
Evidence: Licence, certificates, policies, template and submission proof

Industry obligation: Submit the annual self-assessment to renew Code certification
Due logic: Enter the actual certificate expiry on Dashboard and use an earlier internal target.
Evidence: Completed self-assessment, declaration, supporting evidence and renewed certificate

Due logic: Create the task when the reporting schedule is received; do not invent a legal day.
Evidence: Approved metrics, reconciliation, submission proof and receipt

Industry obligation: Report significant Code breaches and cyber incidents immediately
Trigger: Significant Code breach or cyber incident
Due logic: Use the incident workflow, but keep separate notices and receipts for each recipient.
Evidence: Incident record, materiality assessment, notices, updates and closure
